recommendation_summary: Skip the Odoo rollout and keep the existing shared list. Re-sort it by pickup date, earliest first, and show only orders not yet prepared, ideally as a saved view of open orders due today or earlier. Add a house rule to check that nothing due earlier is still open before starting a cake. Cancel or repurpose the partner booking. The agent offers to inspect the list and set up the view. No ERP and no sync are recommended, even as an option.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need every cake due today prepared before pickup. Payments and stock already reconcile correctly, so nobody needs a new sales or inventory system.
labels.Deleted: The Odoo sales, inventory and manufacturing modules and the counter sync. They replace parts that already work and add a system to run, pay for and maintain.
labels.Bottleneck: Staff work through the list in the order orders were entered, not by pickup date. That is how next month's cakes got made before today's.
labels.Checked myself: Only what you told me: one shared list with customer, pickup date and status that everyone can read at the counter, today's cakes left unmade, and later-entered next-month orders already prepared. I have not seen the list itself.

note: All four record lines come before a bounded due-date view of the existing list, and Odoo and the sync are explicitly rejected.
